**Node.js 22.0.0 GitHub release**

1. **Primary release page** — [Release 2024-04-24, Version 22.0.0 (Current)](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0) on `nodejs/node`. Released 24 Apr 2024 by RafaelGSS (with marco-ippolito). Highlights: `require()` of ESM graphs, WebSocket client, V8 updates. Signed tag `v22.0.0`. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

2. **Official blog announcement** — [Node.js 22 is now available!](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce). Covers V8 12.4 (Wasm GC, `Array.fromAsync`, Set methods, iterator helpers) and experimental `--experimental-require-module`. [[2]](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce)

3. **Official release notes (nodejs.org)** — [Node.js 22.0.0 (Current)](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.0.0) (English equivalent of the French mirror). Notable: drop import assertions, stable watch mode, V8 12.4.254.14, WebSocket on by default, higher stream `highWaterMark`, Maglev on supported arches. [[3]](https://nodejs.org/fr/blog/release/v22.0.0)

4. **Release notes source on GitHub** — [nodejs.org blog markdown for v22.0.0](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md), including download links and SHASUMS. [[4]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)

5. **v22 changelog (all 22.x)** — [CHANGELOG_V22.md](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md) (raw: [CHANGELOG_V22.md raw](https://github.com/nodejs/node/raw/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md)). Lists 22.0.0 through later LTS “Jod” releases. [[5]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md)

6. **Changelog directory** — [nodejs/node `doc/changelogs`](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/master/doc/changelogs). [[6]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/master/doc/changelogs)

7. **Tags index** — [nodejs/node tags](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags). Current line is far past 22.0.0; latest 22.x shown in search is 22.23.3 (LTS). [[7]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags)

8. **Support timeline (not the release page)** — [endoflife.date/nodejs](https://endoflife.date/nodejs): 22 released 24 Apr 2024; active support ended 21 Oct 2025; security support through 30 Apr 2027; latest listed 22.23.3 (23 Sep 2026). [[8]](https://endoflife.date/nodejs)

**Direct link:** https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0
